landing.planEnterpriseF1: Channel and usage limits by agreement
landing.planEnterpriseF4: Deployment and data requirements reviewed individually
landing.modalSubtitle: Leave your contact details to discuss the pilot. No payment is taken.
landing.modalSuccessDesc: Your contact details have been saved for the project owner to review. Automatic email confirmations are not enabled yet.
landing.demoCustomerMsg: “Hello! How much is a BMW F30 diagnostic inspection and can I book for today after 6:00 PM?”
landing.demoAiMsg: “Hello! In this example, diagnostics costs 500 ₴. Please tell us your car model; an operator will confirm availability.”
landing.audiencesSubtitle: Potential use cases for the pilot
landing.audLocalDesc: Auto repair, medical clinics, beauty salons, home services
landing.audLocalPain: Slow replies can leave customer questions unanswered.
landing.audLocalSolution: Goal: help answer common questions and collect booking requests.
landing.audMarketplacesPain: Customers need clear answers about product details.
landing.audMarketplacesSolution: Goal: use verified product facts in supported channels.
landing.audAgenciesPain: Pain: Paid ad traffic is wasted by slow or untrained sales reps.
landing.audAgenciesSolution: Goal: separate workspaces for each client business.
landing.calcFact: Illustration, not a forecast. Assumptions: 35% recovery factor, 40 UAH/USD and a $49 subscription. Costs and margin are excluded.
